title.value: Contrastive Behavioral Similarity Embeddings for Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title directly reflects the focus on learning embeddings for generalization using contrastive behavioral similarity in reinforcement learning.
title.quote: Contrastive Behavioral Similarity Embeddings for Generalization in Reinforcement Learning

analysis.description: This paper presents a novel approach to improving generalization in reinforcement learning by introducing Policy Similarity Embeddings (PSEs). These embeddings are created using a contrastive representation learning procedure and a policy similarity metric (PSM), which measures behavioral similarity between states. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of PSEs across various benchmarks, including LQR tasks and the Distracting DM Control Suite.

type.justification: The paper evaluates the proposed Policy Similarity Embeddings (PSEs) on multiple benchmarks to demonstrate their effectiveness, thus it is empirical in nature.
type.quote: We demonstrate that PSEs improve generalization on diverse benchmarks, including LQR with spurious correlations, a jumping task from pixels, and Distracting DM Control Suite.

name.justification: The paper focuses on improving generalization in reinforcement learning through the introduction of Policy Similarity Embeddings and policy similarity metrics.
name.quote: Reinforcement learning methods trained on few environments rarely learn policies that generalize to unseen environments.

name.justification: The paper discusses learning policy similarity embeddings, which falls under representation learning.
name.quote: We present a contrastive representation learning procedure to embed any state similarity metric.

name.justification: The paper is centered around improving generalization in reinforcement learning by embedding policy similarities.
name.quote: To improve generalization, we incorporate the inherent sequential structure in reinforcement learning into the representation learning process.

name.justification: PSEs are the central deep learning model introduced in the paper, designed to improve generalization in RL.
name.quote: We employ PSM for representation learning and introduce policy similarity embeddings (PSEs) for deep RL.

is_contributed.justification: PSEs are proposed by the authors as a novel method for improving generalization in RL.
is_contributed.quote: We also present a contrastive representation learning procedure to embed any state similarity metric, which we instantiate with PSM to obtain policy similarity embeddings (PSEs).

is_executed.justification: The experiments employ PSEs in practical RL tasks to measure their effectiveness in improving generalization.
is_executed.quote: We demonstrate that PSEs improve generalization on diverse benchmarks.

is_compared.justification: The paper compares the effectiveness of PSEs against other methods for improving generalization in RL.
is_compared.quote: Our approach improves generalization compared to a wide variety of approaches including standard regularization, bisimulation, out-of-distribution generalization, and state-of-the-art data augmentation.
